howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. The video is re-encoded as VP9 at about 1 Mbit/s with Opus audio, which suits HTML5 video on the open web.

faq.a: WebM uses VP9, which is royalty-free and often produces smaller files than H.264 at the same quality. Ideal for hosting video on the open web.
Every modern desktop browser plays WebM. Safari on iOS plays it from iOS 17.4 onward. For maximum compatibility, MP4 is still safer.

faq.q: How much smaller will it be?
faq.a: It depends on the source. The video is encoded at about 1 Mbit/s whatever the input, so a high-bitrate MP4 shrinks a lot while a low-bitrate one can come out larger.
